description: This file exports three functions related to deduplication and suppression of messaging tool replies, acting as an aggregator or index for these functionalities.

methods.name: filterMessagingToolDuplicates
methods.description: Function to filter out duplicate messaging tool payloads.

methods.name: filterMessagingToolMediaDuplicates
methods.description: Function to filter duplicate media payloads in messaging tools.

methods.name: shouldSuppressMessagingToolReplies
methods.description: Function to determine if messaging tool replies should be suppressed.
